description: This file provides configuration utilities for a FastAPI application, including environment variable loading, database URL extraction, and JWT constants. It also defines external dependencies and environment variable references used for connecting to a database and handling JWT authentication.

methods.name: get_supabase_database_url
methods.description: Returns a properly formatted PostgreSQL database URL for Supabase, prioritizing environment variables SUPABASE_DB_URL, SUPABASE_URL, and DATABASE_URL, and adjusting the URL scheme if necessary.
